notes: s004 `לְ` is left `unrepresented` under rule 40: the ASV writes *from afar*, so what the preposition governs is rendered and only its own relation goes unstated, which is exactly the condition rule 40 states.

Competing reading named under rule 8: `לְמִן` read as a compound preposition fused under rules 23 and 30, one unit on s004+s005 headed on the opening morpheme. It is defensible, but rule 40's limit — the governed word keeping an English word of its own — points the other way, so the split stands.
